this-member-s-share-each: This member’s share; each crew member adds the same again.
raises-the-whole-crew-s: Raises the whole crew’s effective level, improving every crew-affected stat (view range, reload, aiming, traverse, ...). Best when the entire crew has it.
situational-effect-not-shown-in: Situational effect not shown in the characteristics above (e.g. fire duration, stun resistance, crew survival).
